notes.title: 1.1.1D Update!
notes.content:
Ho ho ho! Happy Holidays to you all! We are still working on polishing the Demo so it's better, and today is Update time!

New Features:

 Limited-time ???
 Added Speedrun Timer in the Options menu.
 You can now launch yourself forward at great speeds by jumping after sliding for a bit.


Changes:

 Optional Purple Coins now show up with a different icon in the Pause Menu.
 Star boosters now look better and are more animated!


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the Credits Bus playing music for a few seconds after the Honk when entering it.

notes.title: 1.1.0D Update!
notes.content:
Here there everyone! We released an update to the game fixing some issues, and changing a few things for a smoother gameplay experience!

Here's the changelog:

New Features:

 Steam Cloud should be working for the Demo.
 New Options menu with Old School filter.
 The Credits Bus now honks upon spawning.
 Map Name is now shown in the Pause Menu.
 Added 2 Camera Zones to Clubmorial Tower.
 Audio & Visual feedback on Idle Warpers in the Clubmorial Tower.


Changes:

 The First Jump should feel less floaty and a bit faster.
 Camera now has a bigger distance in Zoom mode 3.
 Fixed a typo in one of the place names.
 Coins now take a split second before being able to be collected when coming out of boxes.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed First Person Camera on moving platforms.
 Fixed infinite horizontal distance when spamming B.
 Fixed falling softlock next to the bus.
 Wall Jumps should not be spamming anymore during certain situations.
 Fixed Star Booster material showing the water above it.
 Prevent climbing ledges if a ceiling is above.
